notes: All rates, tenors, reset lags, loan mixes, prepayment parameters, funding availability, and risk limits here are assumed, not measured bank facts.
Net loans are treated as one performing exposure and split into assumed fixed and floating pools; credit losses and allowance movements are excluded.
Existing loan scheduled principal and prepayments run off into cash; no new business, replacement assets, or distributions are modeled.

Bank NII, securities sale PNL and the disclosed hedge earnings are retained in equity. Operating expenses, taxes, non-swap fees, credit losses and OCI are excluded; the stated swap transaction fee is included.
The zero curve is continuous; instrument coupons and the stated cash/funding index conventions are simple annual rates. Cash index is exp(z(0.25)*0.25)-1 divided by 0.25.
Rate shocks are research shapes inspired by common ALM analysis, not calibrated Basel supervisory scenarios.
Deposit maturities represent level principal amortization of modeled stable balances; scenario runoff instead accelerates the designated fraction to immediate repayment in the EVE calculation.

Prefunding adds equal cash and fixed-rate term debt at the base curve index plus spread before the shock. Reactive funding reprices with the shocked index. Both consume the same total incremental funding cap.

Security sales are limited to 80% of opening book and priced by shocked PV divided by base PV for the remaining assumed cash flows. The reported accounting basis of the aggregate securities balance is not reclassified.
Risk limits and feasible-policy outcomes are portfolio research choices, not regulatory or bank-specific conclusions.

Swap trades enter at base-curve par before the instantaneous shock. The first floating fixing is held fixed across scenarios. Later floating coupons and discounting use one Treasury proxy curve; this is not a market SOFR hedge valuation.

Swap initial margin and posted variation margin are assets funded from free cash, earning the disclosed curve-implied collateral remuneration. Received variation margin is fully segregated with an equal return liability, unavailable for deposits or other payments.

The 12-month objective includes bank NII, accrued net swap coupons, posted-collateral interest, securities sale PNL, terminal swap closeout at fair value and the upfront transaction fee. Intermediate derivative marks affect equity but are not counted again on closeout.

Cash settlement prioritizes accrued payment obligations, initial margin, variation margin, then withdrawal requests. Unfunded margin or unpaid obligations remain historical breaches even if later cured. All cash raising shares the original common borrowing/sale caps.
Latest quarterly domestic interest-bearing deposit cost proxy: 0.01819944; the endpoint-average denominator is a proxy, not a reported daily average or current contract quote.
Retain the original 0.5 research assumption; show the historical fitted beta as sensitivity because the lagged model loses to the persistence benchmark on holdout
Reported 2025 noninterest expense divided by opening total assets; a scale assumption, not a cost forecast
Reported 2025 net loan chargeoffs divided by opening net loans; applied to each month beginning net loans as a new noncash asset-loss proxy
Noninterest income, taxes, distributions and OCI are outside the modeled earnings objective. Historical provisions are shown as context and are not charged again on top of the credit-loss proxy.
Sourced bands mix fixed maturity and floating repricing. Assumed fixed/floating splits, representative tenors and gross-to-net allocation remain explicit.

business_costs.operating_basis: Reported 2025 noninterest expense divided by opening total assets; a scale assumption, not a cost forecast
business_costs.credit_basis: Reported 2025 net loan chargeoffs divided by opening net loans; applied to each month beginning net loans as a new noncash asset-loss proxy
business_costs.excluded_income_note: Noninterest income, taxes, distributions and OCI are outside the modeled earnings objective. Historical provisions are shown as context and are not charged again on top of the credit-loss proxy.

assumptions.equity_residual_valuation: static book; zero coupon; excluded from forced sales
assumptions.nonaccrual_valuation: static proportional net book; zero coupon or principal collection; not a recovery forecast
assumptions.encumbrance_allocation: Pro rata original pledged fraction across securities; pledged inventory does not become sellable before its modeled maturity.

limitations: A maturity-or-next-repricing band does not reveal the fixed/floating split or the contractual maturity of floating exposures. Those remain explicit model assumptions.
Other MBS bands report expected weighted average life, not final contractual maturity. A representative cash-flow reconstruction is an assumption.
Equity securities and nonaccrual exposures are outside the performing debt band schedule and remain separately identified.
Public loan bands are gross exposures. Proportional allocation of the total allowance across segments to reproduce net loan book is a modeling bridge, not a reported allowance assignment.

Pledged securities are reported in aggregate. Proportional allocation of encumbrance across debt bands and exclusion of equity securities from forced sales are additional assumptions. Availability of new borrowing remains separately assumed.
Retrieved FDIC data can be revised; observation-date alignment is not evidence the data were published on that date.

Pledged security principal is released into free cash by default. The retain_cash_collateral challenge instead retains it as a separate non-interest-bearing pledged-cash asset throughout the horizon, with no assumed release or substitution. This changes liquidity and subsequent cash income, not the opening contractual EVE cash flows.

notes: All rates, tenors, reset lags, loan mixes, prepayment parameters, funding availability, and risk limits here are assumed, not measured bank facts.
Net loans are treated as one performing exposure and split into assumed fixed and floating pools; credit losses and allowance movements are excluded.
Existing loan scheduled principal and prepayments run off into cash; no new business, replacement assets, or distributions are modeled.

Bank NII, securities sale PNL and the disclosed hedge earnings are retained in equity. Operating expenses, taxes, non-swap fees, credit losses and OCI are excluded; the stated swap transaction fee is included.
The zero curve is continuous; instrument coupons and the stated cash/funding index conventions are simple annual rates. Cash index is exp(z(0.25)*0.25)-1 divided by 0.25.
Rate shocks are research shapes inspired by common ALM analysis, not calibrated Basel supervisory scenarios.
Deposit maturities represent level principal amortization of modeled stable balances; scenario runoff instead accelerates the designated fraction to immediate repayment in the EVE calculation.

Prefunding adds equal cash and fixed-rate term debt at the base curve index plus spread before the shock. Reactive funding reprices with the shocked index. Both consume the same total incremental funding cap.

Security sales are limited to 80% of opening book and priced by shocked PV divided by base PV for the remaining assumed cash flows. The reported accounting basis of the aggregate securities balance is not reclassified.
Risk limits and feasible-policy outcomes are portfolio research choices, not regulatory or bank-specific conclusions.

Swap trades enter at base-curve par before the instantaneous shock. The first floating fixing is held fixed across scenarios. Later floating coupons and discounting use one Treasury proxy curve; this is not a market SOFR hedge valuation.

Swap initial margin and posted variation margin are assets funded from free cash, earning the disclosed curve-implied collateral remuneration. Received variation margin is fully segregated with an equal return liability, unavailable for deposits or other payments.

The 12-month objective includes bank NII, accrued net swap coupons, posted-collateral interest, securities sale PNL, terminal swap closeout at fair value and the upfront transaction fee. Intermediate derivative marks affect equity but are not counted again on closeout.

Cash settlement prioritizes accrued payment obligations, initial margin, variation margin, then withdrawal requests. Unfunded margin or unpaid obligations remain historical breaches even if later cured. All cash raising shares the original common borrowing/sale caps.
Latest quarterly domestic interest-bearing deposit cost proxy: 0.01819944; the endpoint-average denominator is a proxy, not a reported daily average or current contract quote.
Retain the original 0.5 research assumption; show the historical fitted beta as sensitivity because the lagged model loses to the persistence benchmark on holdout
Reported 2025 noninterest expense divided by opening total assets; a scale assumption, not a cost forecast
Reported 2025 net loan chargeoffs divided by opening net loans; applied to each month beginning net loans as a new noncash asset-loss proxy
Noninterest income, taxes, distributions and OCI are outside the modeled earnings objective. Historical provisions are shown as context and are not charged again on top of the credit-loss proxy.
Sourced bands mix fixed maturity and floating repricing. Assumed fixed/floating splits, representative tenors and gross-to-net allocation remain explicit.

business_costs.operating_basis: Reported 2025 noninterest expense divided by opening total assets; a scale assumption, not a cost forecast
business_costs.credit_basis: Reported 2025 net loan chargeoffs divided by opening net loans; applied to each month beginning net loans as a new noncash asset-loss proxy
business_costs.excluded_income_note: Noninterest income, taxes, distributions and OCI are outside the modeled earnings objective. Historical provisions are shown as context and are not charged again on top of the credit-loss proxy.

assumptions.equity_residual_valuation: static book; zero coupon; excluded from forced sales
assumptions.nonaccrual_valuation: static proportional net book; zero coupon or principal collection; not a recovery forecast
assumptions.encumbrance_allocation: Pro rata original pledged fraction across securities; pledged inventory does not become sellable before its modeled maturity.

limitations: A maturity-or-next-repricing band does not reveal the fixed/floating split or the contractual maturity of floating exposures. Those remain explicit model assumptions.
Other MBS bands report expected weighted average life, not final contractual maturity. A representative cash-flow reconstruction is an assumption.
Equity securities and nonaccrual exposures are outside the performing debt band schedule and remain separately identified.
Public loan bands are gross exposures. Proportional allocation of the total allowance across segments to reproduce net loan book is a modeling bridge, not a reported allowance assignment.

Pledged securities are reported in aggregate. Proportional allocation of encumbrance across debt bands and exclusion of equity securities from forced sales are additional assumptions. Availability of new borrowing remains separately assumed.
Retrieved FDIC data can be revised; observation-date alignment is not evidence the data were published on that date.

Pledged security principal is released into free cash by default. The retain_cash_collateral challenge instead retains it as a separate non-interest-bearing pledged-cash asset throughout the horizon, with no assumed release or substitution. This changes liquidity and subsequent cash income, not the opening contractual EVE cash flows.

notes: All rates, tenors, reset lags, loan mixes, prepayment parameters, funding availability, and risk limits here are assumed, not measured bank facts.
Net loans are treated as one performing exposure and split into assumed fixed and floating pools; credit losses and allowance movements are excluded.
Existing loan scheduled principal and prepayments run off into cash; no new business, replacement assets, or distributions are modeled.

Bank NII, securities sale PNL and the disclosed hedge earnings are retained in equity. Operating expenses, taxes, non-swap fees, credit losses and OCI are excluded; the stated swap transaction fee is included.
The zero curve is continuous; instrument coupons and the stated cash/funding index conventions are simple annual rates. Cash index is exp(z(0.25)*0.25)-1 divided by 0.25.
Rate shocks are research shapes inspired by common ALM analysis, not calibrated Basel supervisory scenarios.
Deposit maturities represent level principal amortization of modeled stable balances; scenario runoff instead accelerates the designated fraction to immediate repayment in the EVE calculation.

Prefunding adds equal cash and fixed-rate term debt at the base curve index plus spread before the shock. Reactive funding reprices with the shocked index. Both consume the same total incremental funding cap.

Security sales are limited to 80% of opening book and priced by shocked PV divided by base PV for the remaining assumed cash flows. The reported accounting basis of the aggregate securities balance is not reclassified.
Risk limits and feasible-policy outcomes are portfolio research choices, not regulatory or bank-specific conclusions.

Swap trades enter at base-curve par before the instantaneous shock. The first floating fixing is held fixed across scenarios. Later floating coupons and discounting use one Treasury proxy curve; this is not a market SOFR hedge valuation.

Swap initial margin and posted variation margin are assets funded from free cash, earning the disclosed curve-implied collateral remuneration. Received variation margin is fully segregated with an equal return liability, unavailable for deposits or other payments.

The 12-month objective includes bank NII, accrued net swap coupons, posted-collateral interest, securities sale PNL, terminal swap closeout at fair value and the upfront transaction fee. Intermediate derivative marks affect equity but are not counted again on closeout.

Cash settlement prioritizes accrued payment obligations, initial margin, variation margin, then withdrawal requests. Unfunded margin or unpaid obligations remain historical breaches even if later cured. All cash raising shares the original common borrowing/sale caps.
Latest quarterly domestic interest-bearing deposit cost proxy: 0.01819944; the endpoint-average denominator is a proxy, not a reported daily average or current contract quote.
Retain the original 0.5 research assumption; show the historical fitted beta as sensitivity because the lagged model loses to the persistence benchmark on holdout
Reported 2025 noninterest expense divided by opening total assets; a scale assumption, not a cost forecast
Reported 2025 net loan chargeoffs divided by opening net loans; applied to each month beginning net loans as a new noncash asset-loss proxy
Noninterest income, taxes, distributions and OCI are outside the modeled earnings objective. Historical provisions are shown as context and are not charged again on top of the credit-loss proxy.
Sourced bands mix fixed maturity and floating repricing. Assumed fixed/floating splits, representative tenors and gross-to-net allocation remain explicit.

business_costs.operating_basis: Reported 2025 noninterest expense divided by opening total assets; a scale assumption, not a cost forecast
business_costs.credit_basis: Reported 2025 net loan chargeoffs divided by opening net loans; applied to each month beginning net loans as a new noncash asset-loss proxy
business_costs.excluded_income_note: Noninterest income, taxes, distributions and OCI are outside the modeled earnings objective. Historical provisions are shown as context and are not charged again on top of the credit-loss proxy.

assumptions.equity_residual_valuation: static book; zero coupon; excluded from forced sales
assumptions.nonaccrual_valuation: static proportional net book; zero coupon or principal collection; not a recovery forecast
assumptions.encumbrance_allocation: Pro rata original pledged fraction across securities; pledged inventory does not become sellable before its modeled maturity.

limitations: A maturity-or-next-repricing band does not reveal the fixed/floating split or the contractual maturity of floating exposures. Those remain explicit model assumptions.
Other MBS bands report expected weighted average life, not final contractual maturity. A representative cash-flow reconstruction is an assumption.
Equity securities and nonaccrual exposures are outside the performing debt band schedule and remain separately identified.
Public loan bands are gross exposures. Proportional allocation of the total allowance across segments to reproduce net loan book is a modeling bridge, not a reported allowance assignment.

Pledged securities are reported in aggregate. Proportional allocation of encumbrance across debt bands and exclusion of equity securities from forced sales are additional assumptions. Availability of new borrowing remains separately assumed.
Retrieved FDIC data can be revised; observation-date alignment is not evidence the data were published on that date.

Pledged security principal is released into free cash by default. The retain_cash_collateral challenge instead retains it as a separate non-interest-bearing pledged-cash asset throughout the horizon, with no assumed release or substitution. This changes liquidity and subsequent cash income, not the opening contractual EVE cash flows.

notes: All rates, tenors, reset lags, loan mixes, prepayment parameters, funding availability, and risk limits here are assumed, not measured bank facts.
Net loans are treated as one performing exposure and split into assumed fixed and floating pools; credit losses and allowance movements are excluded.
Existing loan scheduled principal and prepayments run off into cash; no new business, replacement assets, or distributions are modeled.

Bank NII, securities sale PNL and the disclosed hedge earnings are retained in equity. Operating expenses, taxes, non-swap fees, credit losses and OCI are excluded; the stated swap transaction fee is included.
The zero curve is continuous; instrument coupons and the stated cash/funding index conventions are simple annual rates. Cash index is exp(z(0.25)*0.25)-1 divided by 0.25.
Rate shocks are research shapes inspired by common ALM analysis, not calibrated Basel supervisory scenarios.
Deposit maturities represent level principal amortization of modeled stable balances; scenario runoff instead accelerates the designated fraction to immediate repayment in the EVE calculation.

Prefunding adds equal cash and fixed-rate term debt at the base curve index plus spread before the shock. Reactive funding reprices with the shocked index. Both consume the same total incremental funding cap.

Security sales are limited to 80% of opening book and priced by shocked PV divided by base PV for the remaining assumed cash flows. The reported accounting basis of the aggregate securities balance is not reclassified.
Risk limits and feasible-policy outcomes are portfolio research choices, not regulatory or bank-specific conclusions.

Swap trades enter at base-curve par before the instantaneous shock. The first floating fixing is held fixed across scenarios. Later floating coupons and discounting use one Treasury proxy curve; this is not a market SOFR hedge valuation.

Swap initial margin and posted variation margin are assets funded from free cash, earning the disclosed curve-implied collateral remuneration. Received variation margin is fully segregated with an equal return liability, unavailable for deposits or other payments.

The 12-month objective includes bank NII, accrued net swap coupons, posted-collateral interest, securities sale PNL, terminal swap closeout at fair value and the upfront transaction fee. Intermediate derivative marks affect equity but are not counted again on closeout.

Cash settlement prioritizes accrued payment obligations, initial margin, variation margin, then withdrawal requests. Unfunded margin or unpaid obligations remain historical breaches even if later cured. All cash raising shares the original common borrowing/sale caps.
Latest quarterly domestic interest-bearing deposit cost proxy: 0.01819944; the endpoint-average denominator is a proxy, not a reported daily average or current contract quote.
Retain the original 0.5 research assumption; show the historical fitted beta as sensitivity because the lagged model loses to the persistence benchmark on holdout
Reported 2025 noninterest expense divided by opening total assets; a scale assumption, not a cost forecast
Reported 2025 net loan chargeoffs divided by opening net loans; applied to each month beginning net loans as a new noncash asset-loss proxy
Noninterest income, taxes, distributions and OCI are outside the modeled earnings objective. Historical provisions are shown as context and are not charged again on top of the credit-loss proxy.
Sourced bands mix fixed maturity and floating repricing. Assumed fixed/floating splits, representative tenors and gross-to-net allocation remain explicit.

assumptions.equity_residual_valuation: static book; zero coupon; excluded from forced sales
assumptions.nonaccrual_valuation: static proportional net book; zero coupon or principal collection; not a recovery forecast
assumptions.encumbrance_allocation: Pro rata original pledged fraction across securities; pledged inventory does not become sellable before its modeled maturity.

limitations: A maturity-or-next-repricing band does not reveal the fixed/floating split or the contractual maturity of floating exposures. Those remain explicit model assumptions.
Other MBS bands report expected weighted average life, not final contractual maturity. A representative cash-flow reconstruction is an assumption.
Equity securities and nonaccrual exposures are outside the performing debt band schedule and remain separately identified.
Public loan bands are gross exposures. Proportional allocation of the total allowance across segments to reproduce net loan book is a modeling bridge, not a reported allowance assignment.

Pledged securities are reported in aggregate. Proportional allocation of encumbrance across debt bands and exclusion of equity securities from forced sales are additional assumptions. Availability of new borrowing remains separately assumed.
Retrieved FDIC data can be revised; observation-date alignment is not evidence the data were published on that date.

Pledged security principal is released into free cash by default. The retain_cash_collateral challenge instead retains it as a separate non-interest-bearing pledged-cash asset throughout the horizon, with no assumed release or substitution. This changes liquidity and subsequent cash income, not the opening contractual EVE cash flows.

notes: All rates, tenors, reset lags, loan mixes, prepayment parameters, funding availability, and risk limits here are assumed, not measured bank facts.
Net loans are treated as one performing exposure and split into assumed fixed and floating pools; credit losses and allowance movements are excluded.
Existing loan scheduled principal and prepayments run off into cash; no new business, replacement assets, or distributions are modeled.

Bank NII, securities sale PNL and the disclosed hedge earnings are retained in equity. Operating expenses, taxes, non-swap fees, credit losses and OCI are excluded; the stated swap transaction fee is included.
The zero curve is continuous; instrument coupons and the stated cash/funding index conventions are simple annual rates. Cash index is exp(z(0.25)*0.25)-1 divided by 0.25.
Rate shocks are research shapes inspired by common ALM analysis, not calibrated Basel supervisory scenarios.
Deposit maturities represent level principal amortization of modeled stable balances; scenario runoff instead accelerates the designated fraction to immediate repayment in the EVE calculation.

Prefunding adds equal cash and fixed-rate term debt at the base curve index plus spread before the shock. Reactive funding reprices with the shocked index. Both consume the same total incremental funding cap.

Security sales are limited to 80% of opening book and priced by shocked PV divided by base PV for the remaining assumed cash flows. The reported accounting basis of the aggregate securities balance is not reclassified.
Risk limits and feasible-policy outcomes are portfolio research choices, not regulatory or bank-specific conclusions.

Swap trades enter at base-curve par before the instantaneous shock. The first floating fixing is held fixed across scenarios. Later floating coupons and discounting use one Treasury proxy curve; this is not a market SOFR hedge valuation.

Swap initial margin and posted variation margin are assets funded from free cash, earning the disclosed curve-implied collateral remuneration. Received variation margin is fully segregated with an equal return liability, unavailable for deposits or other payments.

The 12-month objective includes bank NII, accrued net swap coupons, posted-collateral interest, securities sale PNL, terminal swap closeout at fair value and the upfront transaction fee. Intermediate derivative marks affect equity but are not counted again on closeout.

Cash settlement prioritizes accrued payment obligations, initial margin, variation margin, then withdrawal requests. Unfunded margin or unpaid obligations remain historical breaches even if later cured. All cash raising shares the original common borrowing/sale caps.
Latest quarterly domestic interest-bearing deposit cost proxy: 0.01819944; the endpoint-average denominator is a proxy, not a reported daily average or current contract quote.
Retain the original 0.5 research assumption; show the historical fitted beta as sensitivity because the lagged model loses to the persistence benchmark on holdout
Reported 2025 noninterest expense divided by opening total assets; a scale assumption, not a cost forecast
Reported 2025 net loan chargeoffs divided by opening net loans; applied to each month beginning net loans as a new noncash asset-loss proxy
Noninterest income, taxes, distributions and OCI are outside the modeled earnings objective. Historical provisions are shown as context and are not charged again on top of the credit-loss proxy.
Sourced bands mix fixed maturity and floating repricing. Assumed fixed/floating splits, representative tenors and gross-to-net allocation remain explicit.

assumptions.equity_residual_valuation: static book; zero coupon; excluded from forced sales
assumptions.nonaccrual_valuation: static proportional net book; zero coupon or principal collection; not a recovery forecast
assumptions.encumbrance_allocation: Pro rata original pledged fraction across securities; pledged inventory does not become sellable before its modeled maturity.

limitations: A maturity-or-next-repricing band does not reveal the fixed/floating split or the contractual maturity of floating exposures. Those remain explicit model assumptions.
Other MBS bands report expected weighted average life, not final contractual maturity. A representative cash-flow reconstruction is an assumption.
Equity securities and nonaccrual exposures are outside the performing debt band schedule and remain separately identified.
Public loan bands are gross exposures. Proportional allocation of the total allowance across segments to reproduce net loan book is a modeling bridge, not a reported allowance assignment.

Pledged securities are reported in aggregate. Proportional allocation of encumbrance across debt bands and exclusion of equity securities from forced sales are additional assumptions. Availability of new borrowing remains separately assumed.
Retrieved FDIC data can be revised; observation-date alignment is not evidence the data were published on that date.

Pledged security principal is released into free cash by default. The retain_cash_collateral challenge instead retains it as a separate non-interest-bearing pledged-cash asset throughout the horizon, with no assumed release or substitution. This changes liquidity and subsequent cash income, not the opening contractual EVE cash flows.

notes: All rates, tenors, reset lags, loan mixes, prepayment parameters, funding availability, and risk limits here are assumed, not measured bank facts.
Net loans are treated as one performing exposure and split into assumed fixed and floating pools; credit losses and allowance movements are excluded.
Existing loan scheduled principal and prepayments run off into cash; no new business, replacement assets, or distributions are modeled.

Bank NII, securities sale PNL and the disclosed hedge earnings are retained in equity. Operating expenses, taxes, non-swap fees, credit losses and OCI are excluded; the stated swap transaction fee is included.
The zero curve is continuous; instrument coupons and the stated cash/funding index conventions are simple annual rates. Cash index is exp(z(0.25)*0.25)-1 divided by 0.25.
Rate shocks are research shapes inspired by common ALM analysis, not calibrated Basel supervisory scenarios.
Deposit maturities represent level principal amortization of modeled stable balances; scenario runoff instead accelerates the designated fraction to immediate repayment in the EVE calculation.

Prefunding adds equal cash and fixed-rate term debt at the base curve index plus spread before the shock. Reactive funding reprices with the shocked index. Both consume the same total incremental funding cap.

Security sales are limited to 80% of opening book and priced by shocked PV divided by base PV for the remaining assumed cash flows. The reported accounting basis of the aggregate securities balance is not reclassified.
Risk limits and feasible-policy outcomes are portfolio research choices, not regulatory or bank-specific conclusions.

Swap trades enter at base-curve par before the instantaneous shock. The first floating fixing is held fixed across scenarios. Later floating coupons and discounting use one Treasury proxy curve; this is not a market SOFR hedge valuation.

Swap initial margin and posted variation margin are assets funded from free cash, earning the disclosed curve-implied collateral remuneration. Received variation margin is fully segregated with an equal return liability, unavailable for deposits or other payments.

The 12-month objective includes bank NII, accrued net swap coupons, posted-collateral interest, securities sale PNL, terminal swap closeout at fair value and the upfront transaction fee. Intermediate derivative marks affect equity but are not counted again on closeout.

Cash settlement prioritizes accrued payment obligations, initial margin, variation margin, then withdrawal requests. Unfunded margin or unpaid obligations remain historical breaches even if later cured. All cash raising shares the original common borrowing/sale caps.
Latest quarterly domestic interest-bearing deposit cost proxy: 0.01819944; the endpoint-average denominator is a proxy, not a reported daily average or current contract quote.
Retain the original 0.5 research assumption; show the historical fitted beta as sensitivity because the lagged model loses to the persistence benchmark on holdout
Reported 2025 noninterest expense divided by opening total assets; a scale assumption, not a cost forecast
Reported 2025 net loan chargeoffs divided by opening net loans; applied to each month beginning net loans as a new noncash asset-loss proxy
Noninterest income, taxes, distributions and OCI are outside the modeled earnings objective. Historical provisions are shown as context and are not charged again on top of the credit-loss proxy.
Sourced bands mix fixed maturity and floating repricing. Assumed fixed/floating splits, representative tenors and gross-to-net allocation remain explicit.

assumptions.equity_residual_valuation: static book; zero coupon; excluded from forced sales
assumptions.nonaccrual_valuation: static proportional net book; zero coupon or principal collection; not a recovery forecast
assumptions.encumbrance_allocation: Pro rata original pledged fraction across securities; pledged inventory does not become sellable before its modeled maturity.

limitations: A maturity-or-next-repricing band does not reveal the fixed/floating split or the contractual maturity of floating exposures. Those remain explicit model assumptions.
Other MBS bands report expected weighted average life, not final contractual maturity. A representative cash-flow reconstruction is an assumption.
Equity securities and nonaccrual exposures are outside the performing debt band schedule and remain separately identified.
Public loan bands are gross exposures. Proportional allocation of the total allowance across segments to reproduce net loan book is a modeling bridge, not a reported allowance assignment.

Pledged securities are reported in aggregate. Proportional allocation of encumbrance across debt bands and exclusion of equity securities from forced sales are additional assumptions. Availability of new borrowing remains separately assumed.
Retrieved FDIC data can be revised; observation-date alignment is not evidence the data were published on that date.

Pledged security principal is released into free cash by default. The retain_cash_collateral challenge instead retains it as a separate non-interest-bearing pledged-cash asset throughout the horizon, with no assumed release or substitution. This changes liquidity and subsequent cash income, not the opening contractual EVE cash flows.

scenarios.description: Parallel +200 bp and 45% requested deposit runoff, with 45% of that runoff requested in month one.

notes: All rates, tenors, reset lags, loan mixes, prepayment parameters, funding availability, and risk limits here are assumed, not measured bank facts.
Net loans are treated as one performing exposure and split into assumed fixed and floating pools; credit losses and allowance movements are excluded.
Existing loan scheduled principal and prepayments run off into cash; no new business, replacement assets, or distributions are modeled.

Bank NII, securities sale PNL and the disclosed hedge earnings are retained in equity. Operating expenses, taxes, non-swap fees, credit losses and OCI are excluded; the stated swap transaction fee is included.
The zero curve is continuous; instrument coupons and the stated cash/funding index conventions are simple annual rates. Cash index is exp(z(0.25)*0.25)-1 divided by 0.25.
Rate shocks are research shapes inspired by common ALM analysis, not calibrated Basel supervisory scenarios.
Deposit maturities represent level principal amortization of modeled stable balances; scenario runoff instead accelerates the designated fraction to immediate repayment in the EVE calculation.

Prefunding adds equal cash and fixed-rate term debt at the base curve index plus spread before the shock. Reactive funding reprices with the shocked index. Both consume the same total incremental funding cap.

Security sales are limited to 80% of opening book and priced by shocked PV divided by base PV for the remaining assumed cash flows. The reported accounting basis of the aggregate securities balance is not reclassified.
Risk limits and feasible-policy outcomes are portfolio research choices, not regulatory or bank-specific conclusions.

Swap trades enter at base-curve par before the instantaneous shock. The first floating fixing is held fixed across scenarios. Later floating coupons and discounting use one Treasury proxy curve; this is not a market SOFR hedge valuation.

Swap initial margin and posted variation margin are assets funded from free cash, earning the disclosed curve-implied collateral remuneration. Received variation margin is fully segregated with an equal return liability, unavailable for deposits or other payments.

The 12-month objective includes bank NII, accrued net swap coupons, posted-collateral interest, securities sale PNL, terminal swap closeout at fair value and the upfront transaction fee. Intermediate derivative marks affect equity but are not counted again on closeout.

Cash settlement prioritizes accrued payment obligations, initial margin, variation margin, then withdrawal requests. Unfunded margin or unpaid obligations remain historical breaches even if later cured. All cash raising shares the original common borrowing/sale caps.
Latest quarterly domestic interest-bearing deposit cost proxy: 0.01819944; the endpoint-average denominator is a proxy, not a reported daily average or current contract quote.
Retain the original 0.5 research assumption; show the historical fitted beta as sensitivity because the lagged model loses to the persistence benchmark on holdout
Reported 2025 noninterest expense divided by opening total assets; a scale assumption, not a cost forecast
Reported 2025 net loan chargeoffs divided by opening net loans; applied to each month beginning net loans as a new noncash asset-loss proxy
Noninterest income, taxes, distributions and OCI are outside the modeled earnings objective. Historical provisions are shown as context and are not charged again on top of the credit-loss proxy.
Sourced bands mix fixed maturity and floating repricing. Assumed fixed/floating splits, representative tenors and gross-to-net allocation remain explicit.

limitations: A maturity-or-next-repricing band does not reveal the fixed/floating split or the contractual maturity of floating exposures. Those remain explicit model assumptions.
Other MBS bands report expected weighted average life, not final contractual maturity. A representative cash-flow reconstruction is an assumption.
Equity securities and nonaccrual exposures are outside the performing debt band schedule and remain separately identified.
Public loan bands are gross exposures. Proportional allocation of the total allowance across segments to reproduce net loan book is a modeling bridge, not a reported allowance assignment.

Pledged securities are reported in aggregate. Proportional allocation of encumbrance across debt bands and exclusion of equity securities from forced sales are additional assumptions. Availability of new borrowing remains separately assumed.
Retrieved FDIC data can be revised; observation-date alignment is not evidence the data were published on that date.

Pledged security principal is released into free cash by default. This changes liquidity and subsequent cash income, not the opening contractual EVE cash flows.

scenarios.name: Rates up + deposit runoff
scenarios.description: Parallel +200 bp and 45% requested deposit runoff, with 45% of that runoff requested in month one.

notes: All rates, tenors, reset lags, loan mixes, prepayment parameters, funding availability, and risk limits here are assumed, not measured bank facts.
Net loans are treated as one performing exposure and split into assumed fixed and floating pools; credit losses and allowance movements are excluded.
Existing loan scheduled principal and prepayments run off into cash; no new business, replacement assets, or distributions are modeled.

Bank NII, securities sale PNL and the disclosed hedge earnings are retained in equity. Operating expenses, taxes, non-swap fees, credit losses and OCI are excluded; the stated swap transaction fee is included.
The zero curve is continuous; instrument coupons and the stated cash/funding index conventions are simple annual rates. Cash index is exp(z(0.25)*0.25)-1 divided by 0.25.
Rate shocks are research shapes inspired by common ALM analysis, not calibrated Basel supervisory scenarios.
Deposit maturities represent level principal amortization of modeled stable balances; scenario runoff instead accelerates the designated fraction to immediate repayment in the EVE calculation.

Prefunding adds equal cash and fixed-rate term debt at the base curve index plus spread before the shock. Reactive funding reprices with the shocked index. Both consume the same total incremental funding cap.

Security sales are limited to 80% of opening book and priced by shocked PV divided by base PV for the remaining assumed cash flows. The reported accounting basis of the aggregate securities balance is not reclassified.
Risk limits and feasible-policy outcomes are portfolio research choices, not regulatory or bank-specific conclusions.

Swap trades enter at base-curve par before the instantaneous shock. The first floating fixing is held fixed across scenarios. Later floating coupons and discounting use one Treasury proxy curve; this is not a market SOFR hedge valuation.

Swap initial margin and posted variation margin are assets funded from free cash, earning the disclosed curve-implied collateral remuneration. Received variation margin is fully segregated with an equal return liability, unavailable for deposits or other payments.

The 12-month objective includes bank NII, accrued net swap coupons, posted-collateral interest, securities sale PNL, terminal swap closeout at fair value and the upfront transaction fee. Intermediate derivative marks affect equity but are not counted again on closeout.

Cash settlement prioritizes accrued payment obligations, initial margin, variation margin, then withdrawal requests. Unfunded margin or unpaid obligations remain historical breaches even if later cured. All cash raising shares the original common borrowing/sale caps.

notes: All rates, tenors, reset lags, loan mixes, prepayment parameters, funding availability, and risk limits here are assumed, not measured bank facts.
Net loans are treated as one performing exposure and split into assumed fixed and floating pools; credit losses and allowance movements are excluded.
Existing loan scheduled principal and prepayments run off into cash; no new business, replacement assets, or distributions are modeled.

Bank NII, securities sale PNL and the disclosed hedge earnings are retained in equity. Operating expenses, taxes, non-swap fees, credit losses and OCI are excluded; the stated swap transaction fee is included.
The zero curve is continuous; instrument coupons and the stated cash/funding index conventions are simple annual rates. Cash index is exp(z(0.25)*0.25)-1 divided by 0.25.
Rate shocks are research shapes inspired by common ALM analysis, not calibrated Basel supervisory scenarios.
Deposit maturities represent level principal amortization of modeled stable balances; scenario runoff instead accelerates the designated fraction to immediate repayment in the EVE calculation.

Prefunding adds equal cash and fixed-rate term debt at the base curve index plus spread before the shock. Reactive funding reprices with the shocked index. Both consume the same total incremental funding cap.

Security sales are limited to 80% of opening book and priced by shocked PV divided by base PV for the remaining assumed cash flows. The reported accounting basis of the aggregate securities balance is not reclassified.
Risk limits and feasible-policy outcomes are portfolio research choices, not regulatory or bank-specific conclusions.

Swap trades enter at base-curve par before the instantaneous shock. The first floating fixing is held fixed across scenarios. Later floating coupons and discounting use one Treasury proxy curve; this is not a market SOFR hedge valuation.

Swap initial margin and posted variation margin are assets funded from free cash, earning the disclosed curve-implied collateral remuneration. Received variation margin is fully segregated with an equal return liability, unavailable for deposits or other payments.

The 12-month objective includes bank NII, accrued net swap coupons, posted-collateral interest, securities sale PNL, terminal swap closeout at fair value and the upfront transaction fee. Intermediate derivative marks affect equity but are not counted again on closeout.

Cash settlement prioritizes accrued payment obligations, initial margin, variation margin, then withdrawal requests. Unfunded margin or unpaid obligations remain historical breaches even if later cured. All cash raising shares the original common borrowing/sale caps.

scenarios.name: Rates up + deposit runoff
scenarios.description: Parallel +200 bp and 45% requested deposit runoff, with 45% of that runoff requested in month one.

notes: All rates, tenors, reset lags, loan mixes, prepayment parameters, funding availability, and risk limits here are assumed, not measured bank facts.
Net loans are treated as one performing exposure and split into assumed fixed and floating pools; credit losses and allowance movements are excluded.
Existing loan scheduled principal and prepayments run off into cash; no new business, replacement assets, or distributions are modeled.

Bank NII, securities sale PNL and the disclosed hedge earnings are retained in equity. Operating expenses, taxes, non-swap fees, credit losses and OCI are excluded; the stated swap transaction fee is included.
The zero curve is continuous; instrument coupons and the stated cash/funding index conventions are simple annual rates. Cash index is exp(z(0.25)*0.25)-1 divided by 0.25.
Rate shocks are research shapes inspired by common ALM analysis, not calibrated Basel supervisory scenarios.
Deposit maturities represent level principal amortization of modeled stable balances; scenario runoff instead accelerates the designated fraction to immediate repayment in the EVE calculation.

Prefunding adds equal cash and fixed-rate term debt at the base curve index plus spread before the shock. Reactive funding reprices with the shocked index. Both consume the same total incremental funding cap.

Security sales are limited to 80% of opening book and priced by shocked PV divided by base PV for the remaining assumed cash flows. The reported accounting basis of the aggregate securities balance is not reclassified.
Risk limits and feasible-policy outcomes are portfolio research choices, not regulatory or bank-specific conclusions.

Swap trades enter at base-curve par before the instantaneous shock. The first floating fixing is held fixed across scenarios. Later floating coupons and discounting use one Treasury proxy curve; this is not a market SOFR hedge valuation.

Swap initial margin and posted variation margin are assets funded from free cash, earning the disclosed curve-implied collateral remuneration. Received variation margin is fully segregated with an equal return liability, unavailable for deposits or other payments.

The 12-month objective includes bank NII, accrued net swap coupons, posted-collateral interest, securities sale PNL, terminal swap closeout at fair value and the upfront transaction fee. Intermediate derivative marks affect equity but are not counted again on closeout.

Cash settlement prioritizes accrued payment obligations, initial margin, variation margin, then withdrawal requests. Unfunded margin or unpaid obligations remain historical breaches even if later cured. All cash raising shares the original common borrowing/sale caps.

curve.interpolation: linear in zero rates; flat outside endpoint tenors
limitations: Fitted off-the-run Treasury research curve, not executable prices or a bank funding curve.
Observation date does not establish historical publication-time availability. This is the revised source vintage captured on 2026-10-02T05:46:36.465711+00:00.
Sub-one-year fitted rates are model extrapolations; the source excludes Treasury bills. This matters for deposit and funding assumptions.

limitations: Designed hypothetical challenges, not realized future observations or empirical out-of-sample performance.

Alternate proxy curves change both projection and discounting and recalibrate the hypothetical inception par coupon at the same frozen hedge notional; this is model specification risk, not repricing an executed trade with unchanged contractual coupon.
No probabilities are assigned to cases. Passing a finite set does not prove robustness between grid points.
A policy failure remains a finding. Selection is never repaired by tuning on the challenge set.
